dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agency administrators, healthcare program leaders, and participants in federal health programs.
dimensions.evidence: each head of a Federal agency that administers a Federal health care program... shall submit to Congress a report on primary care spending

dimensions.assessment: Creates administrative reporting requirements and an advisory working group to study primary care spending and accessibility.
dimensions.evidence: establish a working group... to study and make recommendations

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative costs for report compilation and working group activities, with no direct changes to federal spending amounts or benefit payments.
Amends title XI of the Social Security Act to institute recurrent reporting duties and establish a temporary advisory working group.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XI of the Social Security Act to require reports on primary care spending

dimensions.assessment: Requires ongoing annual agency reporting and a one-time working group study and report.

missing_information: Definitions of primary care spending and primary care providers to be determined by the Secretary.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires federal agencies administering healthcare programs to submit annual reports on primary care spending and establishes an interagency working group to make recommendations.
